positive.prompt: Start a feature in an isolated Git Worktree
Switch back to the Worktree for the interrupted bugfix
Close this work item and archive its SPEC and plan without committing code

negative.prompt: Review this pull request for security problems
Create the implementation plan for this feature

evals.prompt: Start a hotfix from main in a separate Worktree, then explain how to archive its documents safely.
evals.expected_output: A safe lifecycle plan using the deterministic script, isolated Git state, selective document archival, and no remote operations.
expectations: The response validates branch and source-reference safety before creating work
The response isolates concurrent work with a Worktree when needed
The response archives only existing work documents and stages no unrelated files
The response avoids remote or destructive Git operations
